summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 29 April 2026 providing a capitalization table as of 31 March 2026. The table shows equity of £48,231 million and indebtedness of £104,912 million, with £500 million of subordinated liabilities issued on 16 April 2026. No other issuances or redemptions occurred. This is a routine financial reporting filing, not a special situation. There are no deal terms or strategic actions involved.
